lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: GET BACK RIKU, THAT HAND IS MOVING AND IT LOOKS LIKE COLD [beat] GRAY STONE CLAWING AT THE WOOD!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: I’m not waiting around to see if it’s a ghost [beat] I’m getting out of this creepy attic before it grabs us!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: Stop right there and don't you dare touch that door [beat] unless you want to lose your minds forever!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Dada, there is literally a human hand crawling out of the floorboards [beat] why are you acting like this is normal?

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: That is not exactly a person, Nix [beat] it is the guardian of our family’s original name and the forgotten legacy.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: You are sounding more insane by the second [beat] why does the guardian have fingernails like a wild animal?

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: What is all this noise upstairs [beat] I told you kids to stay away from your grandfather’s restricted room today!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Mom, look at the floor [beat] there’s a secret trapdoor and someone is trying to climb through the gap!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Oh my god, Rafiq, it’s finally happening [beat] we didn’t have enough time to prepare the ritual or the basement!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: Everyone get downstairs and lock the kitchen door right now [beat] the Ancestor hasn't been fed in over forty years.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You’ve been keeping a hungry ancestor in the walls this whole time [beat] are you people actually serious right now?

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: He isn’t just an ancestor [beat] he’s the one who earned every cent of the fortune you’ve been spending!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The hand just grabbed my ankle [beat] and it feels like ice-cold metal wrapped in old, dry parchment paper!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Some family secrets are better left buried [beat] but this one just found a way to crawl back up for dinner.
